period_comparison.limitation: Shared observations; descriptive agreement, not an independent combined measurement.

ordinary_dark_occultor_geometry.limitation: A uniform-surface-brightness, circular/small-angle geometry check for an ordinary dark occultor. Limb darkening changes the bounds. Luminous compact-star occultations need separate SED and binary modelling; this is not a universal exclusion.

wide_pair_catalogue_correction.correction: Original report read the empty shifted-control table and incorrectly reported no El-Badry match. A real main-catalogue pair was already in the preserved response.
wide_pair_catalogue_correction.limitation: The catalogue R statistic is not a new measured orbit or a short-period host identification.

scope: Input identities, geometry, catalogue rereading and published-table arithmetic. No complete external raw-cube PRF extraction, evidence integration or independent FPP calibration.
